definitions.explanation: A category or class of things sharing common characteristics. Used to classify or categorize items.
The range of different types available.

examples.japanese: ⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧{種類|しゅるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What kind of music do you like?

examples.japanese: ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{種類|しゅるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are three kinds of cake.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何：00498_nani⟧{種類|しゅるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{載|の}っています→載る：27882_noru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many types of words are in this dictionary?

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{花屋|はなや}→花屋：03136_hanaya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{種類|しゅるい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧で、⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦ごと→〜毎：04012_goto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いろいろな→色々：02352_iroiro⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: This flower shop has a rich variety, and you can enjoy all sorts of flowers each season.

examples.japanese: ⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{種類|しゅるい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}すぎて→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦どれ→どれ：00547_dore⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んでいい→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: There are too many varieties of wine, and I don't know which one to choose.

notes:
{種類|しゅるい} refers to categories or classes of things. It covers both the concept of "type" (a specific category) and "variety" (the range of different types). It can also function as a counter-like word with numbers: ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{種類|しゅるい} (three kinds).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧{種類|しゅるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～: what kind of ~
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{種類|しゅるい}: kinds of ~
- ⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧+{種類|しゅるい}: ~ kinds/types (counter-like usage)
- {種類|しゅるい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧/⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧: many/few varieties
- {種類|しゅるい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧: rich in variety

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦タイプ→タイプ：01534_taipu⟧: type (loanword, casual, often for personality or style)
- ⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧: kind, type (formal, often in compounds like ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧)
- ⟦{品種|ひんしゅ}→品種：11840_hinshu⟧: variety, breed (specifically for plants, animals)
- ⟦{種目|しゅもく}→種目：27734_shumoku⟧: event, category (used for sports or competitions)
